summary: Low-RPM Tip-In Stutter Elimination (ECM 44607 to 2400 RPM & ECM 12163 0.699V to 6.00 lb/h) and Enhanced Safe Decel Pops (ECM 44605 to -4/-6 deg ATDC & ECM 44496 to 1.75s)

changes.parameter_name: Spark Tip-In Torque Control RPM Min
changes.path: Engine / Spark / Advance / Transient / Spark Tip-In Torque Control RPM Min
changes.detail: Raises minimum RPM for transient tip-in torque control from 775 to 2,400 RPM.
changes.rationale: Prevents aggressive 15-17 deg timing chops during low-RPM tip-in (1,200-2,400 RPM) that caused rapid spark oscillations (toggling between 23 and 6 deg) and low-speed bucking/hesitation.

changes.path: Engine / Airflow / General / MAF Calibration / MAF Airflow vs. Voltage
changes.detail: Increases Column 11 airflow by +6.0% (0.0944 -> 0.1000 lb/min, or 5.66 -> 6.00 lb/h).
changes.rationale: Bridges the lean pocket (1.15-1.28 lambda) observed when cracking throttle open from idle/coast across 0.70V-0.88V MAF voltage.

changes.parameter_name: Spark Decel vs. RPM vs. ECT
changes.path: Engine / Spark / Advance / Transient / Spark Decel vs. RPM vs. ECT
changes.detail: Deepens retard for crisper, audible sports-car overrun pops: 2,000 RPM (5/13 -> 2.00 deg), 3,000 RPM (-2.00 -> -4.00 deg), 4,000-6,000 RPM (-4.00 -> -6.00 deg ATDC). Columns 1 & 2 (800 and 1,000 RPM) untouched to guarantee idle catch protection.
changes.rationale: Enhances overrun pop clarity and carry-down safely without excessive exhaust valve thermal load.

changes.path: Engine / Fuel / Cutoff, DFCO / Deceleration Fuel Cutoff / Minimum Time to Delay DFCO
changes.detail: Extends closed-throttle DFCO delay timer from 1.25s to 1.75s.
changes.rationale: Provides a clean, enjoyable ~1.5-1.7 second overrun burble window before injectors cleanly shut off for fuel economy and engine braking.
